reason: Radix renders no content node while the hover card is closed and creates it on the client inside a body portal. The server must ship the HoverCardContent markup somewhere and the trigger (the controller host, an <a>) cannot contain it, so HoverCard::Content emits an inert <template> sibling at its call site. The template has no data-slot, generates no box and its content is not part of the document, so DOM node lists, boxes and accessibility match the oracle. Same pattern as tooltip.
api: HoverCard::Content renders an inert <template data-chadcn--hover-card-template> (no data-slot) holding the content markup while closed

HoverCard takes id: (no Radix prop): the id of the content, the other generated ids being <id>-<part>; Radix numbers ids with React's useId (unique per tree, no caller control); the port numbers them per request with the Rails engine and per render otherwise (Chadcn::Sequence), and the root takes an explicit base
